Most residential and commercial paint is considered household hazardous waste (HHW), which can be disposed of through special collection events or at designated facilities. However, some types of paint are more hazardous than others, and 1-800-GOT-JUNK? may have specific guidelines for handling them. Here are some common types of paint that 1-800-GOT-JUNK? may accept: - Latex paint: This water-based paint is generally considered non-hazardous and can be disposed of through regular trash collection or taken to a recycling center. - Oil-based paint: While considered hazardous, oil-based paint can be disposed of through specialized collection events or at designated facilities. - Epoxy paint: This two-part paint is composed of a hardener and a resin, making it more challenging to handle and dispose of. - Lead-based paint: Due to its hazardous nature, lead-based paint requires special handling and disposal procedures. ### Do 1-800-GOT-JUNK?
